labels.note: related vessel names; only the North Harbor pilot boat is probed

turns.text: You keep the vessel registry of the twin harbors. Record: the pilot boat of North Harbor is called the Petrel; the pilot boat of South Harbor is called the Curlew; the ferry of North Harbor is called the Oystercatcher. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
A captain radios in, registry book not at hand: what is the name of the pilot boat of North Harbor? Answer with just the name.
